# duploai_aws_secret (Data Source)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS Secrets Manager secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an AWS Secrets Manager secret by ID.
data "duploai_aws_secret" "example" {
  workspace_id = "<workspace-id>"
  id           = "<object-id>"
}

output "status" {
  value = data.duploai_aws_secret.example.status
}

output "arn" {
  value = data.duploai_aws_secret.example.arn
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object to look up.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace that owns this secret (path parameter).

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) ARN of the provisioned AWS Secrets Manager secret.
- `aws_secret_id` (String) UUID of this secret, for reference by dependent resources.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the resource.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment that owns the resource group.
- `kms_key_id` (String) KMS key ID used to encrypt the secret. Defaults to the AWS-managed key when omitted.
- `name` (String) Name of the secret resource.
- `provisioner_type` (String) Provisioner type (set by the platform; e.g. DirectApiCall).
- `provisioner_version` (String) Optional provisioner version.
- `resource_group_id` (String) ID of the resource group this secret belongs to.
- `secret_value_type` (String) How the secret value is interpreted: PlainText or Json.
- `status` (String) Current provisioning status.
